abilities.name: Taunt
abilities.description:
<rt.absorb>Taunt</> the target, forcing it to attack you for 6 sec.

<rt.meikoability2>Can be used during Global Cooldown</>

abilities.name: Bash
abilities.description:
<rt.absorb>Interrupt</> the target's spellcasting and prevent it from casting for 4 sec. 
Must interrupt a spell, or it will have no effect.

<rt.meikoability2>Can be used during Global Cooldown</>

abilities.name: Siegebreaker
abilities.description:
For the next 20 seconds, the cooldown reduction granted by your <rt.effect>Veteran of War</> is doubled.

While <rt.absorb>Siegebreaker</>is active, you take 25% reduced damage and your <rt.absorb>Shield Slam</>, <rt.absorb>Shield Throw</> and <rt.absorb>Shockwave</> abilities deal 25% increased damage.

<rt.absorb>SPIRIT ABILITY</>
<rt.greyitalic>When you activate your Spirit ability you gain </><rt.absorb> Spirit of Heroism</><rt.greyitalic>, granting +30% Haste for 20 sec.</>

abilities.name: Iron Wall
abilities.description:
Your <rt.mana>Toughness</> can not be reduced for 12 seconds.

<rt.meikoability2>Can be used during Global Cooldown</>

abilities.name: Grand Melee
abilities.description:
For the next 10 seconds, <rt.effect>Incite</> all enemies in a large radius around you, forcing them to only use <bold>Auto Attacks</> and only attack you.

All allies within the radius of <rt.absorb>Grand Melee</> take 20% reduced magic damage while it is active.

abilities.name: Banner of Hope
abilities.description: Increase all party members <rt.absorb>Maximum Health</> by <rt.heal>20%</> for 15 sec.

abilities.name: Leader's Conviction
abilities.description:
Your damage reduction from <rt.absorb>Toughness</> is shared with all allies for 12 seconds. 

While <rt.absorb>Leader's Conviction</> is active you deal <rt.warning>15% increased damage</>.

<rt.absorb>SPIRIT ABILITY</>
<rt.greyitalic>When you activate your Spirit ability you gain </><rt.absorb> Spirit of Heroism</><rt.greyitalic>, granting +30% Haste for 20 sec.</>

name: Helena
description:
Despite being weighed down by full plate armor, Helena is always ready to charge into the fray to protect her companions.

Helena is a Melee Tank and excels in the front lines taking hits instead of her allies.

Her Veteran of War mechanic allows Helena to reduce the cooldowns of her ability to allow for more frequent use of her powerful attacks and Toughness generators.

Toughness is Helena's main resource for mitigating incoming damage and surviving dangerous encounters. Her Toughness is shown as a blue bar to the right of the character.

talents.name: The Best Defense
talents.description:
Each time you <bold>Block</> an attack with your shield, you have a chance to reset the cooldown of <rt.absorb>Shield Throw</>. Your next <rt.absorb>Shield Throw</> within 12 seconds deals 20% increased damage.

(2.0 PPM)

talents.name: Shield Mastery
talents.description: The cooldown of your <rt.absorb>Shields Up</> and <rt.absorb>Shield Throw</> abilities are reduced relative to the amount of damage you mitigate with <rt.mana>Toughness</>.

talents.name: Sword & Board
talents.description:
Your <rt.absorb>Power Strike</> has a chance to grant you <rt.absorb>Empowered Shield Slam</> for 12 seconds, causing your next <rt.absorb>Shield Slam</> to apply an absorb on you for 2000% Strength that lasts for 8 seconds.

(1.0 PPM)

talents.name: Reinforced Steel
talents.description: Your <bold>Armor</> is increased by 20%.

talents.name: Guarded Veteran
talents.description: Your chance to <bold>Block</> is increased by 10%.

talents.name: Punishing Strikes
talents.description: Your <rt.absorb>Power Strike</> and <rt.absorb>Shield Slam</> deal 15% increased damage.

talents.name: Aftershock
talents.description: Enemies that take damage from your <rt.absorb>Shockwave</> ability take <rt.warning>30% more damage</> from you for 5 seconds.

talents.name: Razor Shrapnel
talents.description: Your <rt.absorb>Shield Throw</> hits have a 20% chance to trigger an explosion of metal, dealing <rt.warning>damage equal to 40% of the Shield Throw hit that triggered the explosion</> to the target and up to 7 additional nearby enemies.

talents.name: Skull Cracker
talents.description: Your <rt.absorb>Shield Throw</> has 20% additional Critical Strike chance and deals 100% increased damage to the first target it hits.

talents.name: Sharpened Blade
talents.description: Enemies affliced by your <rt.absorb>Sweeping Strike's</> bleed have 20% reduced attack speed.

talents.name: High Command
talents.description: Your "Hold the Line" cooldown is reduced by 6 seconds each time you use Shields Up.

talents.name: Magic Ward
talents.description: You take 10% less <bold>Magic damage</>.

talents.name: Commander's Advance
talents.description: Your "Hold the Line" ability increases your movement speed by 50% and the movement speed of your allies by 25% for 5 seconds.

talents.name: Second Wind
talents.description: When your <rt.mana>Toughness</> has reduced an amount of damage equal to 50% of your Maximum Health, you gain 30% increased Strength for 8 sec.

talents.name: Martial Command
talents.description:
While <rt.absorb>Siegebreaker</> is active you deal <rt.warning>25% more damage</> and your damage reduction from <rt.mana>Toughness</> is shared with all allies.

Your <rt.bold>Spirit</> is increased by +5% passively.

talents.name: Gleaming Shield
talents.description: While <rt.absorb>Shields up</> is active your <rt.absorb>Shield Slam</> deals 40% increased damage and all healing effects on you are increased by 20%.

talents.name: Front Line Defender
talents.description: The efficiency of your <rt.mana>Toughness</> mechanic is increased by 20%.

talents.name: Master of War
talents.description: Your <rt.absorb>Grand Melee</> ability has 20% reduced cooldown.

talents.name: Greater Shockwave
talents.description: Your <rt.absorb>Shockwave</> deals 20% increased damage.

lore: Helena is a stern presence within the Fellowship, maintaining a seasoned warrior’s discipline. She uses both the shield she wields to protect others, and to distance herself becoming too familiar with her companions, lest she suffer the burden of loss again.

abilities.name: Heart Bloom
abilities.description:
Conjure a <rt.absorb>Heart Bloom</> at your side that stores <rt.meikoability1>15% of all Flutterfly healing</> you do inside it.

Every 3 seconds, the <rt.absorb>Heart Bloom</> releases a pulse, healing all allies within 4000 radius for an amount equal to the healing it has stored. Lasts 15 seconds.

<rt.absorb>Heart Bloom</> spawns <rt.effect>3 Boomshrooms</> when it withers.

abilities.name: Cure Ailment
abilities.description: Remove all <rt.debuff>Harmful</> <rt.bold>Magic Effects</> from target ally.

abilities.name: Fluttercall: Protect
abilities.description:
Send your <rt.mana>Blue Flutterfly</> to protect target ally.

While your <rt.bold>Blue Flutterfly</> is attached to an ally, that player receives <rt.heal>150% increased healing</> from your <rt.meikoability1>Flutterfly Healing</> effects.

While the <rt.bold>Blue Flutterfly</> is on you, Your <rt.meikoability1>Flutterfly Healing</> on all allies is <rt.heal>increased by 50%</> and all your abilities have <rt.mana>20% reduced mana cost</>.

abilities.name: Hidden Trail
abilities.description:
Your Movement Speed is increased by 50% for 6 seconds.

<rt.absorb>Demure</>
Upon activating <rt.absorb>Hidden Trail</> your threat is reduced by 50% with all enemies.

<rt.meikoability2>Can be used during Global Cooldown</>

abilities.name: Iron Bark
abilities.description:
Target ally takes <rt.absorb>20% reduced damage</> for 12 seconds.

<rt.meikoability2>Can be used during Global Cooldown</>

abilities.name: Safe Haven
abilities.description: Place a <rt.absorb>Safe Haven</> in target location. For the next 15 seconds, all allies standing within the radius have <rt.absorb>40% increased healing taken</>.

abilities.name: Fluttercall: Jubilee
abilities.description:
Call upon <rt.bold>Dream Flutterflies</> to protect up to 4 players by evenly distributing all health between them every 2 seconds over 10 sec.

Upon arriving, the <rt.bold>Dream Flutterflies</> cause <rt.absorb>6 Prickly Vines</> to spontaneously  spawn near you.

<rt.absorb>SPIRIT ABILITY</>
<rt.greyitalic>When you activate your Spirit ability you gain </><rt.absorb> Spirit of Heroism</><rt.greyitalic>, granting +30% Haste and +600% Mana Recovery for 20 sec.</>

abilities.name: Enfeebling Rootsap
abilities.description:
Command one of your <rt.absorb>Prickly Vines</> to <rt.effect>Enfeeble</> target enemy, reducing all damage that enemy deals by 20% for 6 seconds.

The <rt.absorb>Prickly Vine</> withers upon completing it's cast of <rt.absorb>Enfeebling Rootsap</>.

abilities.name: Soothing Touch (old)
abilities.description: Heal target ally for <rt.heal>518% Intellect</>.

abilities.name: Vicious Spores (old)
abilities.description: Conjure dangerous spores to assault the target enemy, dealing <rt.warning>656% Intellect</> damage over 18 sec.

abilities.name: Fluttercall: Embrace
abilities.description:
Recall your <rt.bold>Blue Flutterfly</> to you.

While the <rt.bold>Blue Flutterfly</> is on you, Your <rt.meikoability1>Flutterfly Healing</> on all allies is <rt.heal>increased by 50%</> and all your abilities have <rt.mana>20% reduced mana cost</>.

While your <rt.bold>Blue Flutterfly</> is attached to an ally, that player receives <rt.heal>150% increased healing</> from your <rt.meikoability1>Flutterfly Healing</> effects.

abilities.name: Life Petal: Yellow Flutterfly
abilities.description: Heals you every 2 sec, for 16 sec.

name: Sylvie
description:
Sylvie is a healer who uses her innate connection to nature and its many friends to heal her allies and harm her foes.

Sylvie is a Healer that uses Pet Management Mechanics. She excels at sending her pets to heal her allies over time and attack her enemies.

She commands her Flutterflies and Plants to heal, while her Boomshrooms to attack enemies.

Her powerful Heal over Time spells allow her to prepare for battle and endure long and sustained fights.

talents.name: Nettle to the Petal
talents.description: Each time you deal damage with <rt.absorb>Nettlebolt</>, your <rt.absorb>Life Petal</> triggers an additional tick of its healing.

talents.name: Synchronized Fluttering
talents.description:
Hold down <rt.absorb>Fluttercall: Heal</> for 2 seconds to overcharge it, causing the ability to be cast on up to 4 allies within 4000 range in one cast. The mana cost is increased by 100% when cast in this way.

<bold>Overcharged Abilities</>
Hold down the relevant ability button until a cast bar is displayed. Once the cast has completed, the overcharged version of the ability will trigger.

talents.name: Verdant Restoration
talents.description: The initial heal of your <rt.absorb>Fluttercall: Restore Life</> has +50% increased critical strike chance.

talents.name: Sprouting Nettles
talents.description:
Each tick of <rt.meikoability1>Flutterfly Healing</> has a chance to make your next <rt.absorb>Nettlebolt</> instant cast and have +100% critical strike chance.

(4.0 PPM)

<rt.warning>GRIEVOUS CRITICAL STRIKE</>
Any critical strike chance you have beyond 100% causes a <rt.warning>grievous critical strike</>. <rt.warning>Grievous critical strikes</> increase the base damage of the hit by an amount equal to the overflowing critical strike chance.

talents.name: Natural Knowledge
talents.description: Each time your Nettlebolt deals damage, you replenish 1% mana.

talents.name: Trailing Restoration
talents.description: The duration of your <rt.absorb>Fluttercall: Restore Life</> is increased by 9 seconds.

talents.name: Elusive Wildling
talents.description: You take 20% reduced damage while <rt.absorb>Hidden Trail</> is active.

talents.name: Will of Nature
talents.description: Your healing is increased by 25% on players with <bold>30% or less health</>.

talents.name: Rowdy Rootsap
talents.description: Your <rt.absorb>Enfeebling Rootsap</> causes the target and all enemies within a 700 radius of the target to have 20% reduced attack speed and 50% reduced movement speed while active.

talents.name: Nurtured Haven
talents.description:
The cooldown of your <rt.absorb>Safe Haven</> is reduced each time one of your plants wither.

<rt.absorb>Prickly Vine</> - 1 second
<rt.absorb>Life Petal</> - 2 seconds
<rt.absorb>Heart Bloom</> - 3 seconds

talents.name: Magic Ward
talents.description: You take 10% less <bold>Magic damage</>.

talents.name: Spirited Fortitude
talents.description: You take 10% less <bold>Area of effect damage</>.

talents.name: Natural Protector
talents.description: Your <rt.absorb>Iron Bark</> and <rt.absorb>Safe Haven</> abilities shield players for 15 seconds, absorbing up to <rt.heal>1421% intellect</> damage.

talents.name: Flutterswift
talents.description: Your <rt.absorb>Fluttercall: Heal</> ticks 100% faster for the first 12 seconds each time it begins healing a player.

talents.name: Flower Power
talents.description:
Your <rt.absorb>Heart Bloom</> has 2 charges but only accumulates 10% of all <rt.meikoability1>Flutterfly Healing</>.

The recharge rate of your Heart Bloom is affected by Haste.

talents.name: Bluey's Gambit
talents.description:
While your <bold>Blue Flutterfly</> is following you, you take 5% reduced damage.

While your <bold>Blue Flutterfly</> is following another player, they take 5% reduced damage.

talents.name: Bloomin' Boomshrooms
talents.description:
Your <rt.absorb>Shroomsplosion</> ability can now target allies, sending up to 3 <bold>Boomshrooms</> to detonate on them, instantly healing them for <rt.heal>308% Intellect</> each.

When targeting allies in this way, the <bold>Boomshroom</> still deals its normal damage to nearby enemies.

talents.name: Symbiosis
talents.description: All your <rt.meikoability1>Flutterfly Healing</> is increased by 3% for each <rt.absorb>Prickly Vine</> you have active.

talents.name: Spirited Advance
talents.description: Your <bold>Movement Speed</> is increased by 20%.

talents.name: Bursting Petals
talents.description:
Your <rt.absorb>Life Petal's</> healing is increased by 20% and its healing is front loaded, causing the first tick to heal for twice the amount and ramping down with each tick thereafter.

- NUUKED - waiting for new talent that procs ticks on Life Petal when Nettlebolt deals damage - Axel

talents.name: Shroomageddon
talents.description: Your <rt.absorb>Shroomsplosion</> deals 20% increased damage.

talents.name: In Bloom
talents.description: Your <rt.absorb>Heart Bloom's</> mana cost is reduced by 25%.

talents.name: Heavy Nettle
talents.description: Your <rt.absorb>Nettlebolt</> deals 40% increased damage.

talents.name: Green Thumb
talents.description:
The healing of your <rt.absorb>Life Petal</>, <rt.absorb>Heartbloom</>, and <rt.absorb>Rootsap Revival</> is increased by 20%.

- Nuked for new talent revision -

lore: Abandoned at a young age, Sylvie was taken in and raised by the forest itself. She spent her childhood under the protection of its boughs and learning the natural cycles of magic from her friends, the Flutterflies.

abilities.name: Ice Dash
abilities.description:
Quickly travel forward a short distance.

<rt.meikoability2>Can be used during Global Cooldown</>

abilities.name: Frost Ward
abilities.description:
You take <rt.absorb>40% reduced damage</> for 4 seconds.

<rt.meikoability2>Can be used during Global Cooldown</>

abilities.name: Brain Freeze
abilities.description:
<rt.absorb>Interrupt</> the target's spellcasting and prevent it from casting for 4 sec. 
Must interrupt a spell, or it will have no effect.

<rt.meikoability2>Can be used during Global Cooldown</>

abilities.name: Frigid Winds
abilities.description:
Blast enemies in front of you with arctic winds, <rt.absorb>Knocking Back</> enemies and <rt.absorb>Slowing</> them by 50% for 12 sec.

<rt.meikoability2>Can be used during Global Cooldown</>

abilities.name: Wrath of Winter
abilities.description:
Invoke the spirits of the frozen tundra for 20 seconds, granting you <rt.mana>1 Winter Orb</> every 4 seconds. You deal <rt.warning>+25% increased damage</> and your <rt.absorb>Glacial Blast</> ability is instant cast while <rt.absorb>Wrath of Winter</> is active.

<rt.mana>WINTER ORBS</>
<rt.mana>Winter Orbs</> are required to cast your powerful spender abilities; <rt.absorb>Glacial Blast</> and <rt.absorb>Ice Comet</>.

<rt.effect>SPIRIT ABILITY</>
<rt.greyitalic>When you activate your Spirit ability you gain </><rt.absorb> Spirit of Heroism</><rt.greyitalic>, granting +30% Haste for 20 sec.</>

abilities.name: Ice Blitz
abilities.description:
You enter a state of focused casting for 20 seconds, causing you to deal <rt.warning>20% more damage</> for the duration.

<rt.meikoability2>Can be used during Global Cooldown and while casting</>

abilities.name: Winter's Blessing
abilities.description:
Your <rt.absorb>Spirit is increased by 20%</> for 20 seconds and <rt.heal>30% of all damage you deal is replicated as healing</> divided equally between all allies.

<rt.meikoability2>Can be used during Global Cooldown</>

name: Rime
description:
Channelling the forces of spirit and ice, Rime conjures powerful spells to decimate her foes.

Rime is a Spellcasting Damage Dealer with Builder/Spender Mechanics. She excels at focusing down the biggest threat from a distance.

Many of Rime’s abilities fill an Anima Bar to deal spikes of damage and generate Winter Orbs.

She uses Winter Orbs to cast dangerous spells.

talents.name: Chilling Finesse
talents.description:
Each tick of <rt.absorb>Freezing Torrent</> reduces the cooldown of <rt.absorb>Bursting Ice</> by 0.3 seconds.

Each time you cast <rt.absorb>Cold Snap</> the cooldown of <rt.absorb>Freezing Torrent</> is reduced by 1.5 seconds.

talents.name: Winter's Embrace
talents.description:
While <rt.absorb>Bursting Ice</> is active on an enemy you gain <rt.effect>Winter's Embrace</>, causing you to deal <rt.warning>20% more damage</>.

<rt.effect>Winter's Embrace</> does not affect <rt.absorb>Bursting Ice</>.

talents.name: Glacial Assault
talents.description: Your <rt.absorb>Cold Snap</> ability grants you 1 stack of <rt.effect>Glacial Assault</>. Once you have 4 stacks of <rt.effect>Glacial Assault</>, your next <rt.absorb>Glacial Blast</> is <bold>instant cast</>, deals <rt.warning>40% more damage</> and has <rt.mana>no cost</>.

talents.name: Burstbolter
talents.description: When your <rt.absorb>Frost Bolt</> deals damage to an enemy, it triggers a single pulse of <rt.absorb>Bursting Ice</> and <rt.mana>generates 2 additional Anima</>.

talents.name: Talon's Edict
talents.description:
Your <rt.absorb>Cold Snap</> critical strikes conjure <bold>3 Frost Swalllows</> to instantly attack your enemies.

Additionally, your <rt.absorb>Cold Snap</> and <rt.absorb>Freezing Torrent</> damage has a 15% chance to conjure <bold>1 Frost Swalllow</>.

talents.name: Navir's Keeper
talents.description: Your <rt.absorb>Flight of the Navir</> ability grants 2 charges of <rt.absorb>Cold Snap</>.

talents.name: Icy Flow
talents.description:
Your <rt.absorb>Cold Snap</> grants you <rt.effect>Icy Flow</> for 8 seconds, reducing the cast time of your next <rt.absorb>Glacial Blast</> by 0.5 seconds or reducing the impact delay of your next <rt.absorb>Ice Comet</> by 0.5 seconds.

Both abilities gain <rt.warning>+25% increased critical strike chance</> when consuming a stack of <rt.effect>Icy Flow</>.

You can have up to 2 stacks of <rt.effect>Icy Flow</>.

talents.name: Avalanche
talents.description: Your <rt.absorb>Ice Comet</> has a 15% chance to strike twice, and a 7% chance to strike three times.

talents.name: Coalescing Frost
talents.description:
Each hit of <rt.absorb>Freezing Torrent</> infuses the target with <rt.effect>Coalescing Frost</> for 3 seconds. Once it expires, the afflicted enemy releases a pulse of frost damage in an area around them, dealing <rt.warning>43% Intellect</> damage for each stack of <rt.effect>Coalescing Frost</> that was infused.

<rt.absorb>Freezing Torrent</> critical strikes have a 50% chance to apply 2 stacks of <rt.effect>Coalescing Frost</>.

talents.name: Tundra Guard
talents.description: Your <rt.absorb>Frost Ward</> duration is increased by 2 seconds and while it is active, you heal for 50% of all damage you deal.

talents.name: Greater Glacial Blast
talents.description: Your <rt.absorb>Glacial Blast</> deals <rt.warning>40% more damage</> but its cast time is increased by 0.5 seconds.

talents.name: Magic Ward
talents.description: You take 10% reduced Magic damage.

talents.name: Cascading Blitz
talents.description:
For each <rt.mana>Anima</> you generate while your <rt.absorb>Ice Blitz</> is active, you conjure <bold>1 Frost Swallow</> to attack your target.

The duration of <rt.absorb>Ice Blitz</> is extended by 0.2 seconds each time a <rt.absorb>Frost Swallow</> hits an enemy.

talents.name: Frostweaver's Wrath
talents.description:
Each time you generate <rt.mana>Winter Orbs</>, you have a 17% chance to gain  <rt.effect>Frostweaver's Wrath</> for 12 seconds, causing the next <rt.absorb>Glacial Blast</> or <rt.absorb>Ice Comet</> that deals damage to have <rt.warning>100% additional critical strike chance</>.

<rt.warning>GRIEVOUS CRITICAL STRIKE</>
Any critical strike chance you have beyond 100% causes a <rt.warning>grievous critical strike</>. <rt.warning>Grievous critical strikes</> increase the base damage of the hit by an amount equal to the overflowing critical strike chance.

talents.name: Soulfrost Torrent
talents.description:
Each time you cast an ability you have a chance to gain <rt.effect>Soulfrost Torrent</> for 18 seconds, causing your next <rt.absorb>Freezing Torrent</> to have 40% increased tick rate and <rt.warning>+100% increased critical strike chance</>. (1.5 PPM)

<rt.warning>GRIEVOUS CRITICAL STRIKE</>
Any critical strike chance you have beyond 100% causes a <rt.warning>grievous critical strike</>. <rt.warning>Grievous critical strikes</> increase the base damage of the hit by an amount equal to the overflowing critical strike chance.

talents.name: Biting Cold
talents.description: The power of your Critical Strikes is increased by 10%.

talents.name: Spirited Fortitude
talents.description: You take 10% less Area of Effect damage.

talents.name: Wisdom of the North
talents.description: The cooldown of <rt.absorb>Ice Blitz</>, <rt.absorb>Flight of the Navir</> & <rt.absorb>Winter's Blessing</> is reduced by 0.3 seconds for each <rt.mana>Winter's Orb</> you spend.

talents.name: Talon's Edict (old)
talents.description: Your <rt.absorb>Cold Snap</> conjures an additional wave of <rt.absorb>3 Frost Swallows</> in waves.

talents.name: Harrowing Ice (old)
talents.description: Your <bold>Bursting Ice</> damage is increased by 30%.

talents.name: Coalescing Ice (old)
talents.description: When <bold>Bursting Ice</> deals damage to a single target it generates 2 additional Anima per tick.

talents.name: Chillblain (old)
talents.description: Your <bold>Freezing Torrent</> deals 20% increased damage.

talents.name: Spirited Advance (old)
talents.description: Your <bold>Movement Speed</> is increased by 20%

talents.name: Greater Glacial Blast (old)
talents.description: Your <rt.absorb>Glacial Blast</> has 20% increased critical strike chance.

talents.name: Wicked Blitz (old)
talents.description: Your <rt.absorb>Ice Blitz</> increases all damage you deal by an additional 10%.

talents.name: Chilling Finesse (old)
talents.description: While <rt.absorb>Bursting Ice</> is active on an enemy, you gain 20% Haste.

talents.name: Soulfrost Torrent (old)
talents.description:
Your critical strikes have a chance to cause your next <rt.absorb>Freezing Torrent</> within 12 seconds to have 100% increased tick rate and deal 100% increased damage.

(1.5 PPM)

lore: Blessed or maybe cursed by the spirits of the land, Rime was given the the ability to manipulate the flows of Anima around her. A skill that her tribe thought lost to their past. She uses this ability to manipulate the water and ice around her, teaching her enemies to respect the elemental forces.

abilities.description: Remove all <rt.debuff>Harmful</> <rt.bold>Magic Effects</> from target ally.

abilities.name: Lightshaper's Ward
abilities.description:
Target ally takes <rt.absorb>20% reduced damage</> for 12 seconds.

<rt.meikoability2>Can be used during Global Cooldown</>

abilities.description:
Instantly generate <rt.mana>3 Radiant Runes</>. For the next 8 seconds, any <rt.absorb>Rune Abilities</> you cast are empowered, increasing their effectiveness by 20%.

<rt.meikoability2>Can be used during Global Cooldown</>

abilities.name: Levitate
abilities.description:
Your movement speed is increased by 50% for 6 seconds.

<rt.absorb>Levitation</>
You take 20% reduced Area of Effect damage while levitating.

<rt.meikoability2>Can be used during Global Cooldown and while Casting or Channeling</>

abilities.name: Throw Book
abilities.description:
Educate a target, <rt.absorb>Stunning</> them for 2 sec.

<rt.meikoability2>Can be used during Global Cooldown</>

name: Vigour
description:
As a dwarf who divines the true meaning of runes, Vigour wields powerful healing spells to bolster and protect his allies and smite his enemies.

Vigour is a Healer that uses Builder/Spender Mechanics. He excels in the middle of his allies where he can sustain them with powerful AoE heals.

As a wielder of Radiant Runes, he must choose how and when to cast his most powerful spells.

His strong Direct Healing grant him an advantage in reacting to an ever-changing battlefield.

talents.name: Master of Triage
talents.description:
Each time you generate a <rt.mana>Radiant Rune</>, a free <rt.absorb>Greater Heal</> of 30% efficiency is cast on a nearby ally, preferring the player with lowest health.

<rt.bold>Master of Triage</> does not trigger <rt.absorb>Rune of Renewal</> healing

talents.name: Enduring Light
talents.description: The healing of your <rt.absorb>Circle of Light</> is increased by up to 50% depending on the amount of health the target is missing. Lower health gives a larger bonus.

talents.name: Epiphany
talents.description:
Each time you cast <rt.absorb>Dawnflare</>, <rt.absorb>Soulbrand</> or <rt.absorb>Radiant Blast</> you have a 10% chance to grant you <rt.effect>Epiphany</> for 15 seconds.

<rt.effect>EPIPHANY</>
Your next <rt.absorb>Dawnbreaker Orb</> has no cost and does not trigger its cooldown.

talents.name: Alacritous Healing

name: Tariq
description:
Tariq channels storm and fury to deal immense damage to his enemies.

Tariq is a Melee Damage Dealer that uses Builder/Spender and Timing Mechanics. He excels in the front lines to flank his enemies while they face the Tank.

Timing his abilities around his Swing Timer will maximize his damage and Fury generation.

Fury is required for Tariq to perform powerful attacks.

lore: Tariq comes from a long line of champions. He is strong of hand and stronger of heart. He lived a simple life of calm and peace, but one fateful day, his partner and child were lost in the wars of the Clans.

abilities.name: Fighting Techniques
abilities.description:
Grants access to <rt.mana>Finishing Moves</>  based on <rt.mana>Combo Builders</> used:

<rt.meikoability2>Finisher Techniques can be used during Global Cooldown</>

<rt.meikoability1>PALM TECHNIQUES</> 
<rt.meikoability1>Double Palm Strike</> 
• Grants <rt.bold>+20% Magic Damage reduction</> & <rt.bold>+5% Parry</> for 15 sec.
<rt.meikoability1>Spirited Vortex</> 
• Conjures a Vortex around you that provides <rt.bold>+5% Dodge</>, deals damage to nearby enemies over 18 seconds, and reduces their movement speed by 35% for 5 seconds.

<rt.meikoability2>KICK TECHNIQUES</> 
<rt.meikoability2>Rising Storm</> 
• Deals damage to the target and grants <rt.bold>2 Stormfall</> charges, increasing the damage of your next 2 Lashing Stormkicks by 100%.
<rt.meikoability2>Lashing Stormkick</> 
• Deals damage to target and nearby enemies nearby. Heals you for 200% of the damage it deals.

<rt.meikoability3>FIST TECHNIQUES</> 
<rt.meikoability3>Rising Earth</> 
• Deals damage to the target and grants <rt.bold>2 Earthfall</> charges, increasing the damage of your next 2 Earthfist Barrages by 100%.
<rt.meikoability3>Earthfist Barrage</> 
• Pummels target enemy over 2 seconds and heals you for 200% of the damage it deals.

abilities.description:

<rt.meikoability2>SIBLING OF WIND (controlled)</>
The Sibling of Wind takes 20% of any damage dealt to the Sibling of Earth..

<rt.meikoability3>SIBLING OF EARTH</>
The Sibling of Earth taunts all enemies in a 1000 radius around them every 1.5 seconds. If the Sibling of Earth is destroyed before the duration ends, <rt.absorb>Twin Souls: Bulwark</> ends.

abilities.name: Forbidden Technique
abilities.description:
Your <rt.absorb>Double Palm Strike</> finisher applies <bold>Forbidden Technique</> to the target for 15 seconds.

<bold>Forbidden Technique</> accumulates 15% of all damage you deal to the target. Once it expires, is removed, or if the enemy dies while it is active -  the accumulated amount explodes on the target and onto nearby enemies. You are healed for 100% of the damage dealt by <bold>Forbidden Technique</>.

You can only have one <bold>Forbidden Technique</> active at any time.

name: Meiko
description:
As a martial artist, Meiko utilizes a variety of fighting techniques to empower herself and defend her allies.

Meiko is a Melee Tank that uses Ability Combo Mechanics. She excels in the front lines taking hits instead of her allies.

She uses Ability Combos to perform powerful Finishing Moves.

Big cooldowns and self buffs allow her to mend her own wounds and survive dangerous attacks.

lore: Evil destroyed her home and her purpose, now only she remains. Meiko cannot undo what has happened to her people, but she can avenge them. That will be her purpose now.

name: Helena
description:
Despite being weighed down by full plate armor, Helena is always ready to charge into the fray to protect her companions.

Helena is a Melee Tank and excels in the front lines taking hits instead of her allies.

Her Veteran of War mechanic allows Helena to reduce the cooldowns of her ability to allow for more frequent use of her powerful attacks and Toughness generators.

Toughness is Helena's main resource for mitigating incoming damage and surviving dangerous encounters. Her Toughness is shown as a blue bar to the right of the character.
lore: Helena is a stern presence within the Fellowship, maintaining a seasoned warrior’s discipline. She uses both the shield she wields to protect others, and to distance herself becoming too familiar with her companions, lest she suffer the burden of loss again.
